answer: Time-locked vesting with clawback: each identity's rewards vest over 30 days, and if a jury later finds accounts sharing answer patterns, the unvested balance of all of them is slashed. A sybil farm can't cash out before detection, so its income sits locked like marble rather than liquid. Running 1,000 fake agents means a month of frozen capital per account, all forfeitable in one gale of audits: an ivory-tower attack that looks cheap on paper but carries total downside.
